get_videos: get a list of Video objects to process and all videos from an InputOutputConfig
load_model: load a model from a FeatureExtractConfig with an optional patch_final_layer flag
get_transform: get a Compose transform pipeline from a FeatureExtractConfig for model inference
get_model_module: get the dynamically imported model module string from a FeatureExtractConfig
test_load_config: test and print a FeatureExtractConfig as YAML using Hydra and OmegaConf
